note: Family-run since 1966: a 250-acre campground with stables at 141 Trackrock Camp Rd between Blairsville and Hiawassee, bordered by the Chattahoochee NF; level shady sites, private swimming/fishing lake, playgrounds, game room; 5 cabins. summary: Operator's rate card priced it: full-hookup RV $45 a night, $50 in July and October (fees were unset; tent $30 not counted). CampLife (camplife.com/1282) is the engine but asks for a login to show availability/prices - the operator's own posted rates and phone keep it in (AWH 10-14 #3). 95 campsites (operator), 55 RV sites sold online, 40 ft max, pull-through; hookups/facilities now operator-sourced; booking platform/url added. Equestrian: stables and trail rides are a side business; camping is for 'tents, popups and RVs' - a general campground. Phone 706-745-2420 matches site and CampLife; address now 141 Trackrock Camp Rd (note's 4887 replaced). Under the $50 gate (July/October exactly $50). Pin within ~150 m of the sites. 3-night minimum: see flags.
flags: 3-night minimum: neither trackrock.com (rates, FAQ, cancellation pages) nor CampLife's public record states one, and CampLife hides its booking rules behind a login. The note's 'holiday weekends' wording was kept unsourced; nothing found says it applies outside holiday weekends, so not a standing-minimum drop. Only October has a stated special rule (two-night DEPOSIT, 30-day cancellation), not a minimum.
CampLife requires a login to see availability or prices ('Please log in to see availability'). Kept per AWH 2026-10-14 #3: the operator's own site posts its rates and phone.
Long-stay (passes): monthly $810 + metered electric is offered except July/October, but nightly rates are posted and 55 RV sites are sold online nightly; nothing suggests residents or lots for sale.

Water (minor lead, not a contrary claim): the operator advertises 'Swimming and fishing in our private lake' and a 'Large lakeside fire pit', and CampLife has a 'Water-front' amenity, but no RV site type carries it. The pond (~1.5 ha) sits ~100 m east of the office; stored 'not waterfront' left.
